evidence./valid: Whether the proposed edit or pending transaction validates.
evidence./pixels: Before and after values, owners and protection for a bounded sample.
evidence./pixelCount: Total changed pixels before truncating the sample.
evidence./targets: Requested destinations, resolved source identities, affected runs or modifier IDs as applicable.
evidence./sources: Actual scene entities and fields changed in the preview.
evidence./conflicts: Blocking validation issues, including current and expected revisions when applicable.
evidence./warnings: Additional review evidence, including an unpinned source revision when applicable.
evidence./diff/cells: Every changed composite or layer cell with before and after values in exact mode.
evidence./diff/materials: Authored material fields, source splat channels and scan texels before and after.
evidence./diff/geometry: Authored geometry, modifiers, footprints and topology before and after.
evidence./diff/rendered: Untruncated, matched native render differences for reviewed scene views.
evidence./diff/skippedHits: Skipped projection hits, brush falloff and reported rejected pixel or source hits.
evidence./diff/protection: Changed protection definitions and cells, and protected hits blocked by validation.

validation.static: Validate the command against this schema. For a custom destination, resolve its kind from the live document and validate its operation using that destination’s reference.
validation.runtime: The Ink editor checks live IDs, bounds, palette, source capabilities, locks, revisions and evidence. Source adapters are CLI flags or SDK context, outside the command JSON.
validation.examples: Open a fresh editor for exampleDocument for each example, execute setup commands in order, then execute command.
